g.text: Lorenz: convergence does not ensure better accuracy
Each dot is one session, averaging its questions under the named condition. The same sessions appear in all three panels.
Left means less disagreement after revision. Down means a more accurate full-session geometric mean.
Lorenz et al. (2011) | doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1008636108 | Released data: Almaatouq et al. (2022) repository
Before = round 1, before feedback about that question. After = round 5. All 12 recorded answers enter each group estimate.
Observed session changes on the released rows; no simulated trajectories, fitted response model, or additional outlier exclusions.
